input.description:
Input of this mocked action.

If this is null, it will match any input.

rootUrl.description: Root url where mocked requests are stored / saved.

refreshMocks.description: If true then will not mock but instead will call target action and save requests under #rootUrl.

useUniqueResponses.description:
Make every response distinct even if the type and inputs to the action are the same.
Typically in a test, the mocked action has to return different values based on the sequence within the test.
The mockFiles will be distinct based on the value of a static global counter. This is useful to mock an external
REST point in an integration-test where requests are serialized. Note that the sequence is global to the test
so it will only work if the full test class is run as a whole.

claims.description:
Lambda that should return `true` if it mocks action with provided input.

If this is null, it will match everything.

impl.description: Lambda that should return result of this action mocks for provided input.
